checks.name: generated_runner_identity
checks.evidence: All 18 current builder replacements have a unique anchor; replaying them in memory against the unchanged P3 runner exactly reproduces the generated runner text.

checks.name: bounded_patch_identity
checks.evidence: Replaying only the literal replacements in patch_runtime_gates.py against the frozen round-1 builder/controller exactly reproduces the current files. No implementation write was executed by this review.

checks.name: unaffected_inputs
checks.evidence: All 12 unaffected round-1 input files are byte-identical to their frozen reviewed hashes, including PLAN, refiner, source preparation, native model/criterion and the currently running P3 runner.

checks.name: eight_real_native_mask_losses
checks.evidence: The helper tuple exactly lists the eight terms produced by native SetCriterion.loss_masks (losses.py:562-639), accumulated at :924-931 and exposed at :964-971. The last prefix has the nonempty native Text/Query/alpha outputs, so each term is a Tensor with a differentiable native Mask branch; earlier-prefix float zeros do not make the accumulated term a Python constant. The current batch contains valid root targets, as required by the existing G path.

checks.name: separate_gradient_assertions
checks.evidence: Helper :13-21 calls autograd.grad separately for each of the eight losses against every refiner parameter, retaining the graph for the eventual training backward. None is allowed for unused parameters; any materialized gradient must be elementwise exactly zero. This cannot hide cancellation between losses or parameters, and autograd.grad does not accumulate into parameter .grad.

checks.name: native_event_sequence
checks.evidence: Helper :55-63 matches native pv_ground.py:454-547: proposal; heads 0..5; x_query; for each sample one Text prediction, three SWA/FFN/Text predictions, final Text prediction and one Query Mask; then the enabled tail. Batch8 has 105 events with the tail and 104 for intentional bypass: proposal1, each head1, x_query1, each SWA8, each SWA-FFN8, Text40, Query8, enabled refiner1. Exact list equality rejects reordered, missing or extra observed calls.

checks.name: interception_transparency
checks.evidence: The registered pre-hooks append a Python label and return None. Both temporary method intercepts forward unchanged *args/**kwargs to the saved bound originals and return their exact result. Successful forwards restore those originals and remove all hooks before checking event equality. No tensor operation, parameter/buffer write, extra native forward, or RNG draw is added by observed_forward. A failing disposable process cannot emit a passed receipt.

checks.name: all_four_preflight_forwards
checks.evidence: Runner :351 and :356 observe the initial enabled/bypass forwards. Its two-step loop at :390 invokes step, whose preflight branch at :285 observes each training forward and whose :313 performs all eight Mask-loss checks before backward/update. The receipt is written only after all existing checks and the new len(witnesses)==4 assertion at :424. Per-loss values are retained in each step record; each call witness retains complete order/counts and enabled role.

checks.name: controller_training_gates
checks.evidence: Controller :47-52 requires passed status, two updates, matching arm, existing gates, direct_native_mask_loss_to_refiner_gradients_zero, native_call_order_verified and exactly four witnesses before spawning train. This same block is reached by the default flow and train-after-preflight. Old/incomplete receipts cannot satisfy it. Existing current-P3 completion, paired-raw completion and disk gates remain unchanged.

checks.name: preflight_only_instrumentation
checks.evidence: The new observed forward and Mask-loss autograd checks run only in mode=preflight. Normal training keeps its original model(inputs) call; formal evaluation is unchanged. The helper is imported and checked against the existing per-spec hash convention, and pending deployment must supply that helper and tail_preflight_module_sha256 in its specs.

checks.name: stdlib_behavior_checks
checks.evidence: Explicit Python stand-ins, without torch/model imports, exercised argument/result identity, repeated method restoration and hook removal, expected 105/104 event lengths, rejection of an extra Text Mask call, invocation of all eight gradient checks, individual rejection of each of eight nonzero loss gradients, and rejection of four old/incomplete controller proofs. These test Python mechanics only and do not establish native Tensor/CUDA behavior.

runtime_and_deployment.note: This is a source/static/stdlib acceptance of the bounded fix. Actual native Tensor/CUDA checks, restore, memory measurements and deployment receipts remain unexecuted. Full training still requires the current P3 completion gate and passed real preflight receipts for each arm; no new accuracy or completed-run claim is made.
